LanguageData.VFEC_HeatStones.description: A thin square box made of stone, perforated with tiny holes at the bottom and top. A small fire can be lit and sustained within. The stone container will slowly dissipate heat, allowing prolonged passive warmth.
LanguageData.VFEC_HeatStones.label: heat stones
LanguageData.VFEC_LargePassiveCooler.description: A sturdy unpowered cooler notably larger than the traditional variety, cools rooms to freezing via water evaporation. Will run out and self-destruct after several days.
LanguageData.VFEC_LargePassiveCooler.label: large passive cooler
